releaseNotes:
1. Authoritative Crossings Database Consolidation: Synchronized Crossings Abstract and Register to use single authoritative CrossingDatabaseService (detected_feeder_crossings, 60 records) with zero discrepancy.
2. 5 Approved Categories: Strictly enforced NH, SH, Main River, Railway, and EHT / Power Line across abstract, register, editor, import, and export.
3. Crossings Abstract Theming: Replaced conflicting dark cards with theme-adaptive cards and high-contrast typography in light and dark modes.
4. Route Verification Dialog: Resolved button row horizontal clipping, ensuring Confirm and Reverse actions are fully visible across all mobile displays.
